gameEditor.antiCheat: Don't use SavePoint with online games protected by anti-cheat. Changed game files can get your account flagged, and those games can't be modded or rolled back anyway.
gameEditor.artwork.appId.helper: Only used to find this game's artwork. It's the number after /app/ in the game's Steam store address.
gameEditor.artwork.appId.label: Steam app ID (optional)
gameEditor.artwork.appId.saveFirst: Save to look up the new ID.
gameEditor.artwork.label: Artwork
gameEditor.artwork.pickTitle: Choose a picture for this game
gameEditor.cloudSaves: Turn off cloud saves for this game in its store, such as Steam Cloud or GOG Galaxy. Otherwise the store can sync older saves over the ones SavePoint puts back.
gameEditor.consent.message: {count, plural, one {SavePoint takes snapshots of everything in this folder. When you switch profiles, it makes the folder match that profile: it puts files back and removes files that profile doesn't have. It also leaves a small file in the folder to remember you chose it. Make sure this is the right one.} other {SavePoint takes snapshots of everything in these folders. When you switch profiles, it makes the folders match that profile: it puts files back and removes files that profile doesn't have. It also leaves a small file in each folder to remember you chose it. Make sure these are the right ones.}}
gameEditor.consent.title: {count, plural, one {Confirm this folder} other {Confirm these folders}}
gameEditor.discard.message: You've changed this game without saving. Going back now throws those changes away.
gameEditor.discard.title: Discard your changes?
gameEditor.export.successUnsaved: Exported the saved version of {name}. Changes you haven't saved yet aren't in the file.
gameEditor.external.label: Where the saves live
gameEditor.external.missingNote: No saves folder is set yet. Saves are often kept outside the game's own folder, in Documents or Saved Games, and many games only make that folder the first time you play. Until you add it here, SavePoint keeps snapshots of the game's files but not of your saves.
gameEditor.ignorePaths.label: Files to leave out
gameEditor.ignorePaths.helper: SavePoint never copies or replaces files that match these rules, such as logs. Use * for any name and ** for any folder. Don't add a rule that matches your saves, or profiles stop switching them.
gameEditor.import.success: Loaded {name} from the file. Nothing is saved until you choose Save changes.
gameEditor.install.browseAutomation: Browse for the game's install folder
gameEditor.install.label: Where the game is installed
gameEditor.launch.exe: {os, select, windows {Run the .exe} macos {Run the app} other {Run the program}}
gameEditor.launch.exeBrowseAutomation: Browse for the file that starts the game
gameEditor.launch.exeNeedsInstall: Choose the install folder first, so the start file can be shown relative to it.
gameEditor.launch.exeOutside: That file isn't inside the game's install folder. Pick the file that starts the game from inside {folder}.
gameEditor.launch.exePickTitle: Choose the file that starts the game
gameEditor.launch.label: How to start the game
gameEditor.launch.steamHelper: Steam launch links look like steam://run/123456. The number is in the address of the game's store page.
gameEditor.launch.steamWarning: Starting through Steam can let Steam update the game again right after SavePoint puts your version back. {os, select, windows {Running the .exe} macos {Running the app} other {Running the program}} avoids that.
gameEditor.launchArgs.label: Extra command-line options
gameEditor.modPathHints.helper: SavePoint keeps everything in the install folder either way. This only changes what History counts as a mod change.
gameEditor.modPathHints.label: Folders that hold mods
gameEditor.name.label: Name
gameEditor.processName.helper: Used when the launcher closes itself before the game opens.
gameEditor.processName.label: Knowing when you've stopped playing
gameEditor.processName.linkWhy: This game starts through a link, so SavePoint can't see its program. Without the game's program name here, SavePoint can't tell when you've stopped playing, and you'll have to say so yourself.
gameEditor.reconnect.message: A game you removed from SavePoint used this folder, and its snapshots are still here. Reconnect to bring back its profiles and snapshots, or start fresh and leave them unused.
gameEditor.reconnect.title: This folder has snapshots from before
gameEditor.folderMismatch.title: Is this the right folder?
gameEditor.folderMismatch.message: The {role, select, install {game install folder} external {saves folder} other {folder}} you picked, {path}, holds only {presentCount} of the {recordedCount} files in its latest snapshot. If it is the wrong folder, switching profiles or discarding changes could delete files that belong to something else there. Use this folder anyway?
